title: God Mode AI OS — workspace.yaml (mesh declaration, PH11-T01)
description: Structure consumed by scripts/workspace_declare.py. Validated structurally (dependency-light, no jsonschema package) by scripts/validate_os.py inside the gate. One per workspace: what it is, what it depends on, what it serves, and which North-Star ladder stage (.ai/north-star.yaml) its work advances.

role.description: What this workspace is, in the operator's own words. Never guessed by the AI — the same authorship rule .ai/plan.md's 'What I want' section already holds.

success_criteria.description: What 'done' or 'working' looks like for this workspace. Optional — absence means undeclared, not zero.

depends_on.description: Workspace names this workspace's outcome depends on. Edge reciprocity is validated by a later slice (fleet-map), not this schema.

serves.description: Workspace names this workspace's output feeds. May be empty for infrastructure workspaces that serve everything generically — explain why in `notes` rather than inventing a false edge.

ladder_stage.description: Which .ai/north-star.yaml stage this workspace's work advances. null/absent means undeclared, never guessed — the same 'refuses rather than invents' contract north_star.score() already uses for a stage with no exit_criterion.

notes.description: Free text for anything the structured fields can't say honestly — e.g. why depends_on/serves is empty for an infrastructure workspace.
